FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Tech Haven Electronics, we specialize in the retail of consumer electronics and provide comprehensive repair services for a wide range of devices including smartphones, laptops, tablets, and home audio equipment. Our operations focus on delivering quality products at competitive prices while ensuring exceptional customer service. 

Our store, located in a bustling commercial area, enables us to engage directly with customers, allowing for personalized assistance and support. We maintain a well-organized inventory management system to efficiently track products and repairs, ensuring a seamless customer experience.

All our technicians are trained and certified, adhering to industry standards to guarantee professional repairs. We pride ourselves on our dedication to safety and compliance, having successfully operated at our current location for over three years without any major theft or safety incidents.

Moreover, we have implemented strong customer service protocols to address inquiries and warranty claims promptly. While online sales are a component of our business model, we ensure that less than 75% of our revenue comes from this channel, maintaining a strong in-person retail presence to mitigate certain liabilities. 

At Tech Haven Electronics, we are committed to providing reliable services and fostering long-term customer relationships, all while ensuring a safe and secure shopping environment.

Our electronics store and repair shop has been serving customers by providing quality service and products since we opened our doors at this location, and we are proud to have been here for over two years, helping the community with their electronic needs.

The business has maintained a clean record, with no incidents of theft, burglary, or vandalism reported in the past 3 years. All operations are compliant with safety regulations and effective loss prevention measures are in place."
